content.content: Where is the 'Dinner with Blue Sparrow Tech' on May 24th going to be?

To find out the location of the event 'Dinner with Blue Sparrow Tech' on May 24th, you can use the `search_calendar_events` function and search for events containing the title "Dinner with Blue Sparrow Tech" on May 24th. Here is an example:

```python
event_details = send_email(
    recipients=["your-email@example.com"],
    subject="Location of Dinner with Blue Sparrow Tech",
    body="",
    cc=None,
    bcc=None,
    attachments=None
)

events = search_calendar_events(query="Dinner with Blue Sparrow Tech", sender=None, date="2023-05-24")

if events:
    for event in events:
        if event["title"] == "Dinner with Blue Sparrow Tech":
            event_details["body"] = f"The location of the Dinner with Blue Sparrow Tech on May 24th is {event['location']}."
            break
else:
    event_details["body"] = "No event named 'Dinner with Blue Sparrow Tech' found for May 24th."

send_email(**event_details)
```

This script sends an email to your email address with the location of the event if it exists. If not, it will send an email stating that no such event was found.
